purpose: Validated inventory of institutions/platforms that host DIGITIZED yearbooks relevant to St. Louis-area schools. Used to build the school x archive coverage matrix that drives Track B fan-out: each worker is dispatched only to archives already known to hold its school.

digital_yearbooks_statuses.confirmed: digital yearbook collection verified to exist (browseable or API-enumerable)
digital_yearbooks_statuses.partial_or_small: digital yearbooks exist but coverage is narrow/scattered
digital_yearbooks_statuses.none_found: no digital yearbook collection found; institution may hold physical copies only
digital_yearbooks_statuses.adjacent_source: not yearbooks, but a related digital source covering the same schools/era

policy.note: Decided 2026-10-08: only a freely-accessible scan with institutional provenance (school/district-hosted, or a cataloged object held by a named library/archive/university, incl. institution-contributed archive.org items) fully removes a (school, year) from the scan-target missing-set. Free scans with weak provenance (archive.org aggregator/unknown contributors, volunteer sites) are recorded + flagged rescan_recommended. Commercial/paywalled aggregator sources are out of scope entirely and are not listed in this inventory.
policy.archive_surface_note: Every archive is a search surface for the FULL 337-school target list — never assume coverage is limited to the institution's own name. University archives in particular may hold other schools' yearbooks (e.g. UMSL hosts the Western Historical Manuscript Collection and the SHSMO St. Louis Research Center, both of which collect community/school records). A university's OWN yearbook only contributes coverage if that university is itself a target school in schools_master.json (UMSL is believed in-scope; Washington University is believed not to be — verify against seed zips at diff time). For public grade/high schools, self-hosted coverage means the school's own DISTRICT site (a Florissant school's yearbook lives on the Ferguson-Florissant district site, not a Ferguson municipal site) — the per-school search surface is bounded.

authority_tiers.1: school/district self-hosted or school-affiliated society — strongest provenance; investigate first per school
authority_tiers.2: institutional custody — public/university library or archive holding a cataloged object
authority_tiers.3: last resort — free but weak provenance (Internet Archive mixed contributors, volunteer scans); record existence, rescan_recommended

provenance_tiers.institutional: scan of a cataloged object held by a named library/archive/university; suppresses scan target
provenance_tiers.aggregator: faithful page images but unknown physical source / commercial scanning origin; recorded + rescan_recommended
provenance_tiers.unknown: provenance unclear; treat as aggregator until verified

enumeration_methods.browse_index: institution publishes a school-level collection index; enumerate once, diff against seed
enumeration_methods.api: school-level list retrievable via API or structured endpoint
enumeration_methods.single_school: DEPRECATED 2026-10-08 — do not use. A university archive is a search surface for the whole target list; never assume it holds only its own institution's yearbooks.
enumeration_methods.per_school_search: no index; must keyword-search per school name

coverage_statuses.index_enumerated: archive's full school/collection index was pulled and diffed against all 342 seed schools (2026-10-09). covered_schools is the COMPLETE set of our schools present in that index — if a school_id is absent from it, this archive has nothing for that school in listed material. Excluded from future searches for any school not listed.
coverage_statuses.spot_checked: covered_schools lists only manually-confirmed hits; catalog was NOT enumerated — still requires per-school keyword search for every unlisted school
coverage_statuses.unsearched: never queried; no enumerable index — must be searched per school in any future sweep
coverage_statuses.dead_host: site unreachable as of 2026-10-09; exclude unless it comes back up

archives.coverage_status: index_enumerated (113 school collections listed; 25 unique seed schools matched — the spine, most coverage lives here)
archives.name: St. Louis County Library — Digital Archives (St. Louis Yearbooks collection)
archives.enumeration_notes: Recollect CMS. School-level subcollections enumerable via browse endpoint: https://slcl.recollectcms.com/nodes/search?bid=<collection-node-id>&orderby=node_title&order=asc . St. Louis Yearbooks collection node 1267 (~90 school subcollections, ~1,404 items); separate 'Other Missouri Yearbooks' and 'Other State Yearbooks' collections exist and may cover St. Charles/Franklin counties. Post-2000 volumes may be in-branch only.

archives.coverage_status: index_enumerated (324 school names in the 2015 holdings table; 20 unique seed schools matched; post-2015 acquisitions unindexed)
archives.name: St. Louis County Library — physical holdings list (History & Genealogy closed stacks)
archives.enumeration_notes: Flat alphabetical table (~1,149 rows, list dated Aug 2015; live page 403s bots — use Wayback snapshot). Includes non-Missouri schools and non-yearbook items (directories, indexes).
archives.notes: Physical holdings are a lower bound vs. digital (digital-only additions like Beaumont 1929 are absent). Useful for homeroom-archive scan-priority decisions.

archives.coverage_status: index_enumerated (yearbook-collections search; 11 unique seed schools matched; hits flag rescan_recommended per provenance policy)
archives.name: Internet Archive (archive.org) — yearbook collections
archives.enumeration_notes: advancedsearch API, e.g. collection:(yearbooks OR yearbook-archive). Includes a large mirror of classmates.com scans with identifiers like 'classmates-yearbook-<id>-<year>-<school-name>' — confirmed STL examples: SLU High 1983 (#30903), DeSmet Jesuit 1968 (#8908). Also library-contributed collections. Per-item provenance: check the item's contributor/collection metadata — institution-contributed items are provenance=institutional; classmates-mirror and unknown-contributor items are provenance=aggregator -> rescan_recommended.
archives.notes: Free alternative surface for much of the Classmates corpus; item titles/identifiers encode school+year so coverage can be derived without account.

coverage_matrix_plan.step_1: For every archive with enumeration_method browse_index/api, produce the school-level list once (one fetch/API call per collection, not per school). University archives get an extra orientation probe of their full collections index — they may hold other schools' yearbooks; own-institution series only counts if the university is itself a target school.
coverage_matrix_plan.step_2: Normalize archive school names and diff against schools_master.json name+aliases using the core-token matching in find_potential_duplicates.py; geography (city/ZIP) disambiguates decoys.
coverage_matrix_plan.step_3: Emit archive_coverage.json mapping school row_id -> [archive_ids with presence=true]; unresolved name matches get flagged for human review, never silently merged.
coverage_matrix_plan.step_4: Track B workers are then dispatched per (archive, its covered schools) — each worker extracts per-year volumes only for known-present pairs. per_school_search archives form a fallback tier for schools with zero coverage.
